name: @kku/shared
//exports: The root barrel re-exports subpaths that reach node:crypto / aws-sdk, so a `'use client'` React component cannot import runtime values from it. `./pipeline/program-phases` and `./scholar/parse` are published as explicitly client-safe subpaths (pure functions + types, no node:* and no SDK imports) — the first for the two admin pipeline pickers, the second so the profile page validates a pasted Scholar URL with the SAME parser the API rejects it with, rather than a second copy that drifts. Only bundler-style resolvers (apps/web, esbuild) read this map — apps/api, apps/ingestion and packages/db use moduleResolution 'node' and still resolve via `main`.
